items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: So later years, there was three of them: Billy Strayhorn, Jimmy Blanton and Ben. They went out together.

ctx.x: I've heard descriptions of Jimmy Blanton as a nice quiet, very friendly, nice person. Did he have any trouble? Was it easy for him to take care of Ben? Ben was kind of volatile, wasn't he?

Yes, but he respected Blanton and his musicianship. He says all right Bear, okay Bear, they give him the name Jack the Bear. So later years, there was three of them: Billy Strayhorn, Jimmy Blanton and Ben. They went out together.
Billy watch Ben too? Billy never --
